description: Election Commission - G. P. Y. Kanthi elected as Chairman of the Weligama Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the office of Chairman of the Weligama Urban Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of an elected official to fill a vacancy created when the previous chairman ceased to be a member of their political party. This falls under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral procedures, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
